name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted AI agent for teams and communities with typed graph memory, background workers, a web dashboard and Discord, Slack and Telegram adapters.

alerts.message: Spacebot has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with SPACEBOT_USERNAME and SPACEBOT_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Then add an LLM provider API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter or another supported provider) under Settings before the agent can answer.
